title: UK CPI — October 2026 consumer price inflation (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET), the first print containing the electricity VAT zero-rating, and the first the 05 November MPC could not see
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukoctober2026, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: October 2026', 'Release date: 18 November 2026 7:00am', and states 'This release is not yet published'. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: and no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01 LANE, 2026-09-09. This is the SCORING VENUE for that event and the only print where its effect is observable: the GB domestic-electricity zero rate takes effect 1 October 2026 under SI 2026/987 (made 2026-09-07, laid 09-08, in force 10-01), so October is the first month it enters the index. TWO REASONS IT EARNS A CALENDAR SLOT RATHER THAN A LEDGER FOOTNOTE. First, TIMING: it publishes 13 days AFTER the 05 November MPC vote, so the committee must forecast the VAT effect rather than observe it — the November MPR embeds a legislated cut the print then tests. Second, ATTRIBUTION: the cut is worth 0.098pp of CPI (ONS CPI electricity weight 20.6065/1000, series CJXA fetched 2026-09-09, times the 4.7619% VAT-inclusive price fall of 5/105), which reproduces gov.uk's stated 'around 0.10 percentage points' exactly. A UK October headline printing ~0.1pp softer than a naive model is therefore A TAX CHANGE, NOT DISINFLATION, and reading it as a dovish surprise is the specific error the parent ledger exists to prevent. The number to watch is the ELECTRICITY INDEX (CPI 04.5.1), not the headline: at 0.098pp against a series published to one decimal the headline effect may round away entirely, while Ofgem's October cap (+4% overall, gas +8%, electricity-only households 'less than 1%') gives the electricity index a clean, falsifiable prediction. Registered as FT-uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01-1. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no rates- or sterling-keyed house playbook, and the calendar's whole symbol universe is eight US mega-caps. Estimate widens caution only.
